decisive_items: novel heterozygous missense variant, c.6832G>T, p.Gly2278Trp, in COL7A1 (NM_000094)
response.rationale: The presence of dermoepidermal separation and a novel variant in the COL7A1 gene supports the diagnosis of Dystrophic Epidermolysis Bullosa, which is more specific than Inherited Epidermolysis Bullosa
